items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Basia used to come out there, sit on the track... He'd be sitting out there, he wouldn't have no horn. He'd want to come in and blow something

ctx.x: Some of them used to get them on Saturday night, be out there all night and did. Then, you know, we catch a band out there, you know, and brought one another, you know. Basia used to come out there, sit on the track, but he's out there listening, looking, you know. Wanted to try to get in, you know. See, they wouldn't get high, Basia, you know. They wouldn't hire him? Basia would get drunk, raise some much sand, you know. He was drinking out there? A young boy, too. He'd be sitting out there, he wouldn't have no…
